newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 27.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 27.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Protestors continued to camp in tents outside of parliament in a bid to block a proposed law on restoring property to former owners. The campers say the law could throw them into the streets.

- The Lithuanian appeals court upheld a decision by the Vilnius district court to sentence purported gangster Henrikas Daktaras to seven and a half years of hard labour. Daktaras' lawyers plan to appeal to Lithuania's supreme court.
